pain: The Event Ledger has no package and no Workers toolchain, so no code can run or be tested in the Cloudflare Workers runtime that hosts its Durable Object.
who: HOME's trusted internal consumers: Collectors that append Activity Events and Projections that replay them.
done_when: packages/event-ledger exists as workspace @zs-home/event-ledger with canonicalize pinned to exactly 5.1.0 as its only runtime dependency.

devDependencies are pinned exactly: @cloudflare/vitest-plugin 1.8.5, wrangler 4.165.0 and @cloudflare/workers-types 5.20261119.1 (or generated wrangler types instead of workers-types), and vitest stays at the root's 5.1.1.
The root package.json engines floor is >=22.12.0, and the package declares the same.

packages/event-ledger/wrangler.jsonc has compatibility_date 2026-11-18, compatibility_flags ["nodejs_compat"], the EVENT_LEDGER Durable Object binding and a new_sqlite_classes migration for EventLedgerObject, and no account_id, routes or deploy script.

The root vitest.config.ts runs the existing Node tests and the event-ledger Workers project together, and a runtime test inside the Workers pool runs createHash('sha256') from node:crypto and a CREATE TABLE ... STRICT inside ctx.storage.transactionSync on a stub object.
npm run typecheck and npm run lint cover the new package, CI workflows are unchanged, and npm audit --audit-level=high reports 0 vulnerabilities.
npm ci and npm run check pass on a fresh checkout with no Cloudflare account or login, with the PR Evidence section naming the head SHA.
